pinned_source.title: Unique k-SAT and General k-SAT
pinned_source.author: Timon Hertli
pinned_source.license: No source-code license asserted; clean-room mathematical algorithm

contract.formula: 3-CNF with exactly three literals over distinct variables in each clause; positive v means x_(v-1), negative -v means its negation.
contract.randomness_projection: The uniform assignment beta and uniform variable permutation are supplied explicitly; one trace is deterministic.
contract.implication: A currently unassigned variable is t-implied when some nonempty subset of at most t=floor(log2(n)) clauses has at least one satisfying completion under the current partial assignment and every satisfying completion fixes that variable to the same bit.
contract.tie_breaking: Choose the lowest-index forced variable, then the lowest numeric clause-subset bitmask that implies it. Repeat before each permutation variable; use beta only when the current variable remains unset.
contract.profile_scope: Bounded deterministic PPSZ trace; no randomized success-probability or unique-solution guarantee is claimed.

workspace.meaning: Fixed clause arrays, partial assignment, and staged output for n<=8 and m<=12.
